scope: source-only; Research owner keyed retry idempotency

change.summary: Non-empty idempotency_key retries use a deterministic experiment id from sha256(parent, effective actor, key); under a pg advisory xact lock, the attempt insert (compare_and_set expected=None) and ticket link (CAS loop) share one experiments_store.transaction() conn, so replay returns the existing canonical record without mutation and failure rolls back both. No-key path unchanged.

probe.before: FAIL (retry-before.log): 3 distinct attempt-2 records and 3 ticket links
probe.after: PASS exit 0: single retry id, 2 experiments, 2 ticket links

tests.test_doubles: _InMemoryOwnerStore / _InMemoryStore gained transaction(), advisory_xact_lock() and compare_and_set() with undo journal and a shared RLock; no production fallback added.

evidence_class: fake-store logic and SQL-emulating fake connection over the real PostgresJsonOwnerStore code only. No real PostgreSQL available (no psycopg/postgres in env); no process restart, browser, or hosted evidence.
